name: Ugo
self_text: Hi! I'm Ugo, an American guy in my mid 20s. When I'm not spending my time swing dancing, which I love for the energy and rhythm, I'm usually on my PC. My main game is Skyforge Arena, and I generally queue for casual matches. In terms of my role, I play damage. I'm looking for someone to coach me to help me improve. Regarding communication, I use either voice chat or text chat while playing. I have a few specific windows of availability: I am free on Saturday morning, Saturday afternoon, or Sunday afternoon. Looking forward to getting some games in!

requests.request_text: I need you to play a support role or be flexible about your role, and you have to be the one who coaches me. It's a deal-breaker unless you are into Skyforge Arena and are available Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon. I'd strongly prefer that you enjoy casual matches, though it's not a requirement.
